svg.title: Field kit
svg.desc: Artifacts my tools parse: Windows: $MFT, $UsnJrnl, $LogFile, $I30, Registry hives, Amcache, Prefetch, SRUM, EVTX, LNK, USB history, Shadow copies, RDP bitmap cache, pagefile · hiberfil; Apple & mobile: SQLite + WAL, plists, NSKeyedArchiver, binary cookies, WebKit, iPhone pairing records, iPhone backups; Cross-platform: Browser history, Bluetooth, Wi-Fi hotspots, Phone Link, KDE Connect, AirDrop. Toolchain: Suites: EnCase, Magnet AXIOM, Cellebrite, Belkasoft, FTK, Autopsy, Inspector; Acquisition: Tableau, Digital Collector, UFADE; IR & triage: CrowdStrike Falcon, Cado, KAPE, Velociraptor; Open source: EZ Tools, RegRipper, Hayabusa, Chainsaw, Hindsight, iLEAPP, mac_apt; Built with: Python, Rust, Perl, PySide6 · PyQt, Flask, egui, SQLite.
